# https://www.ecovluu.com/ llms-full.txt

> Ecovluu is a Dublin, Ireland-based hair care brand selling premium natural hair care products — sulfate-, paraben-, and silicone-free shampoos and deep conditioning masks formulated with proteins, keratin, niacinamide, and botanical extracts for dry, damaged, and color-treated hair. Founded by hairstylist Catalina Baciu, operated by Lab Organic Cosmetics Ltd (t/a Ecovluu).

## About Us

URL: https://www.ecovluu.com/about (implied)

Discover the story behind ECOVLUU. Ecovluu develops premium natural hair care products to restore, hydrate, and strengthen hair using professional formulas.

### Trusted Ingredients

- **Crambe Abyssinica Oil** — Deeply hydrates without weighing hair down. Reduces frizz and smooths the hair cuticle.
- **Genadvance® Life** — Chosen for its ability to breathe new life into tired, dry hair.
- **Keratin** — Rebuilds hair structure, fills in damaged areas, and improves elasticity and strength.
- **Saffron Extract** — Rich in antioxidants. Protects hair from environmental stressors and maintains color vibrancy.
- **Amino Acids Complex** — Strengthens hair roots, stimulates growth, and prevents breakage by reinforcing structural bonds.
- **Aloe Vera Extract** — Soothes the scalp, balances hydration, and adds natural shine and softness to every strand.

Section heading: "Trusted Ingredients. Proven Results."

### Founder

**Catalina Baciu, founder** — Ecovluu was founded on the belief that hair care should be both natural and effective. As a hair care specialist with 25 years of experience, the founder set out to create products that deliver salon-quality results at home using clean, premium ingredients.

### Routine Steps (as illustrated on the About page)

1. **Apply** — Apply a small amount of shampoo to damp hair, massage into a rich lather, and rinse.
2. **Restore** — Distribute the conditioning mask evenly through damp hair, focusing on lengths and ends.
3. **Wait** — Leave the mask on for 5–10 minutes to allow the natural active ingredients to penetrate deeply.
4. **Enjoy!** — Enjoy the result: nourished, shiny and hydrated hair.

## Product: Deep Hydrating Shampoo

URL: https://www.ecovluu.com/product/deep-hydrating-shampoo
SKU: DP-HYD-SHM
Reviews: 26 (5.0 average)

Badges: sulfate-free / no SLS, no SLES, gentle cleanser, professional hair care

⚠️ **Patch Test Recommended:** Before first use, apply a small amount to a discreet area and wait 24 hours to check for any adverse reactions.

### Key Ingredients (highlighted)
- **Aqua** — Purified Water Base. Forms the base of the formula and helps everything else mix and work smoothly together.
- Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate
- Cocamidopropyl Betaine
- Sodium Lauroamphoacetate
- Sodium Hydroxymethylglycinate

### Clinical / Survey Results (self-reported, dry hair segment)
Based on a customer survey of 68 verified purchasers:
- 92% reported softer, smoother hair after first wash
- 88% noticed reduced scalp irritation within one week
- 100% would recommend to someone with dry hair

### Education: Why Hair Hydration Matters
Hair is roughly 95% protein, but without adequate moisture even healthy protein bonds can become brittle and prone to breakage. Dry hair has a disrupted cuticle layer that lets moisture escape, making hair look dull, feel rough, and tangle easily. Real hydration requires ingredients that penetrate the cortex and bind water inside the hair shaft rather than just coating the surface. The Deep Hydrating Shampoo uses humectants such as Sodium Lactate and Panthenol alongside Sodium Lauroamphoacetate to cleanse and replenish at the same time, so hair doesn't lose more moisture than it gains from each wash.

Did-you-know callout: hair can absorb up to 30% of its own weight in water — when it can't retain moisture, it becomes brittle, not just dry.

Posts:

3. [Dry vs Dehydrated Hair: How to Tell the Difference and Fix It Naturally](https://www.ecovluu.com/blog/dry-vs-dehydrated-hair) — Ecovluu, January 6, 2026
4. [Ecovluu – The Honest Beginning of a New Haircare Era](https://www.ecovluu.com/blog/beginning-new-haircare-era) — Ecovluu, October 1, 2025 (also duplicated at a second slug: /blog/Ecovluu%20%E2%80%93%20The%20Honest%20Beginning%20of%20a%20New%E2%80%A8Haircare%20Era)

### Post: Dry vs Dehydrated Hair — How to Tell the Difference and Fix It Naturally

Dry hair and dehydrated hair are often used interchangeably but describe two different problems, and picking the right routine depends on knowing which one you have.

**Dry hair** lacks lipids (natural oils), often for genetic reasons but worsened by harsh cleansers, over-washing, or environmental exposure. Signs: rough texture, lack of shine, increased friction and breakage. It responds best to gentle cleansing and formulas that protect the scalp's natural oil balance — the article points to the Deep Hydrating Shampoo as an example of a gentle, mild-surfactant option.

**Dehydrated hair** lacks water, not oil, typically from heat styling, chemical treatments, environmental stress, or under-conditioning. Signs: stiffness, frizz, and hair that feels dry but turns greasy quickly. It needs deep hydration and moisture retention — the article points to the Deep Conditioning Mask as a way to restore moisture and elasticity.

Hair can be **both** dry and dehydrated at once, which is common. The recommended two-step routine: cleanse gently to protect natural oils, then treat lengths with an intensive hydrating mask, rebalancing both oil and water levels in the fiber.

Suggested routine: start with a gentle cleansing shampoo, follow with a deep conditioning mask, and avoid aggressive surfactants and excessive heat. Consistency matters more than overloading hair with product.

Key takeaway: dry and dehydrated hair need different but complementary care, and understanding which one you're dealing with lets you build a routine that restores softness, strength, and shine without unnecessary stress on the scalp or fiber.

### Post: How to Hydrate Dry Hair Without Weighing It Down

A common fear for people with dry or dehydrated hair is that hydration will leave hair heavy, flat, or greasy — a valid concern, since many products overload hair with oils and silicones instead of delivering real hydration, coating the hair while it stays dehydrated underneath.

The article argues hydration should never mean added weight. The fix is prioritizing water-binding ingredients over heavy occlusives, starting with a gentle, balanced cleansing step since scalp and lengths have different needs (pointing to the hydrating shampoo), then concentrating hydration on mid-lengths and ends with an intensive mask for dry/damaged hair that restores softness and elasticity without residue or overload (pointing to the mask).

Frequency matters too: hydration works best applied consistently rather than excessively — the right products in the right order beat over-applying rich treatments. If hair feels soft right after washing but dry again the next day, the issue is a lack of balance, not a lack of product. Properly hydrated hair stays flexible, light, and responsive to styling — it moves naturally, reflects light, and feels comfortable rather than stiff, greasy, or coated. Done right, hydration doesn't just make hair look better — it behaves better.

### Post: Why Dry Hair Needs Both Water and Lipids – The Balance Most Routines Miss

Many routines treat dry hair by layering on more and more oil, assuming more oil equals more hydration. In reality, dry hair is rarely just short on oil — it's usually short on water, internal structure, or both. Real improvement comes from correcting the balance between water and lipids inside the hair fiber, not from adding more product.

Hair fiber is made of water, lipids, and proteins: water provides internal hydration, lipids protect the surface, and proteins give strength and elasticity. When one or more of these is compromised — through frequent washing with aggressive surfactants, heat styling, UV exposure, chemical treatments, or environmental dehydration — hair becomes rough, dull, tangle-prone, and breakage-prone.

Oils and butters matter, but only at the right moment: if hair lacks internal water, oil can seal the surface but can't hydrate the fiber itself, which can leave hair temporarily smoother but eventually stiff, heavy, or coated. Hydration has to come first; lipids should follow to protect and preserve that hydration rather than replace it.

Recommended sequence: gentle cleansing that removes buildup without stripping the scalp or fiber, then restoring internal moisture with water-binding ingredients and amino acids, then — only after hydration is re-established — introducing lipids to smooth the cuticle, reduce moisture loss, and add softness and shine.

When water and lipids are balanced, hair feels soft without greasiness, keeps its shape and elasticity, detangles easily, and reflects light naturally — the difference between temporary cosmetic softness and hair that's genuinely healthier over time. Consistency beats heavy, infrequent treatments; healthy hair builds up progressively through routines that respect both scalp and fiber. The core message: dry hair doesn't need more product, it needs the right balance — water first, lipids second, structure supported continuously.

### Post: Ecovluu – The Honest Beginning of a New Haircare Era

In a crowded haircare market full of promises of instant repair and overnight transformation, the article argues hair — like people — thrives on balance rather than empty claims: balance between strength and softness, performance and gentleness, science and nature. That idea is presented as the founding principle of Ecovluu.

Written from the founder's perspective as a hairstylist with more than 25 years of experience: after seeing countless products come and go — some working briefly, many disappointing, few genuinely respecting both hair and scalp — and after watching clients repeatedly struggle with the same issues, the founder created Ecovluu. The brand is described as having originated not purely in a lab, but in the salon chair, through client conversations and real, observed needs.

## Privacy Policy

URL: https://www.ecovluu.com/privacy-policy
Last updated: 7/20/2026

Ecovluu is committed to protecting visitor privacy and explains how it collects, uses, shares, and protects information collected via www.ecovluu.com or through purchases.

**Information collected:** personal information (name, email, billing/shipping addresses, phone number), payment details at purchase, technical data (IP address, device type, browser version), and information collected via cookies.

**How the information is used:** to process orders and payments, provide customer support, communicate order updates, send promotional emails, improve site performance, and tailor product recommendations.

**Sharing:** data may be shared with trusted third-party service providers such as payment processors (e.g., Stripe) and shipping companies. Ecovluu states it does not sell or rent personal data, and requires partners to protect data and comply with GDPR.

**Cookies & tracking:** used to improve browsing experience and analyze site performance; users can control cookie preferences via browser settings, though disabling cookies may affect site features.

**GDPR rights (EU residents):** access personal data, correct inaccurate data, delete data ("right to be forgotten"), restrict use of data, request a portable copy of data, and object to processing for marketing purposes. Requests go to info@ecovluu.com.

**Legal bases for processing:** contractual necessity (orders, payments, delivery, support), consent (marketing communications, non-essential cookies), and legitimate interests/legal obligations (site improvement, fraud prevention, legal compliance).

**Data retention:**
| Data Type | Retention Period |
|---|---|
| Transaction Data | 6 years |
| Marketing Data | Until unsubscribe |
| Technical Data | 12 months |
| Support Data | 2 years |

**Security:** SSL encryption, secure server storage, and regular system monitoring.

**Supervisory authority:** Ireland's Data Protection Commission (DPC) — www.dataprotection.ie, 21 Fitzwilliam Square South, Dublin 2, D02 RD28, Ireland, +353 578 684 800.

**Contact:** info@ecovluu.com; A6, Block A, Santry Business Park, Swords Road, Santry, Dublin 9, Ireland.

## Return & Refund Policy

URL: https://www.ecovluu.com/return-refund-policy
Last updated: 7/20/2026

**1. Right of Withdrawal (EU consumers)** — 14 calendar days to withdraw without reason, expiring 14 days after the consumer (or a third party they designate, other than the carrier) takes physical possession of the goods. Must inform Ecovluu via a clear statement to info@ecovluu.com; an optional model withdrawal form is provided (see below).

**2. Effects of Withdrawal** — All payments received, including standard delivery cost, are reimbursed (excluding extra costs from choosing non-standard delivery). Reimbursement may be withheld until goods are received back or proof of return is supplied, whichever is earlier. Refunds use the original payment method unless otherwise agreed, issued no later than 14 days after Ecovluu is informed of the withdrawal.

**3. Conditions for Returns** — Goods must be sent back within 14 days of communicating withdrawal; must be unused, unopened, with intact safety seals, original packaging, and resalable condition. Customers are liable only for value loss from handling beyond what's needed to check the nature/characteristics/functioning of the goods.

**4. Hygiene & Safety Exception (Cosmetic Products)** — Per Article 16(e) of Directive 2011/83/EU, sealed goods unsuitable for return for health/hygiene reasons once unsealed are excluded from the right of withdrawal; opened, unsealed, or used hair care/cosmetic products cannot be returned.

**5. Return Shipping Costs** — Customer pays return shipping unless goods are defective, damaged, or incorrect (in which case Ecovluu covers it). Tracked shipping is recommended; Ecovluu isn't responsible for items lost in return transit.

**6. Defective or Incorrect Products** — Contact within 48 hours of delivery with order number, description of the issue, and clear photos of product and packaging. Ecovluu offers a replacement or full refund including shipping where applicable.

**7. Exchanges** — No direct exchanges; return the original item and place a new order instead.

**8. How to Return an Item** — Email info@ecovluu.com to initiate; return instructions are provided after the request is reviewed.

**9. Model Withdrawal Form (optional)** — Addressed to Ecovluu, info@ecovluu.com, containing: order number; order/receipt date; consumer name and address; signature (paper submissions only); date.
